scripts.dev: docker compose up -d dynamodb mailpit && npm run start:local
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm -w @care-circle/ui-card run build && npm -w @care-circle/dashboard run build && npm -w @care-circle/simulator run build
scripts.start:local: tsx scripts/ensure-env.ts && tsx --env-file=.env scripts/reset-local.ts && npm -w @care-circle/ui-card run build && concurrently -k -n auth,api,dash,sim-ui,sim-agent -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm -w @care-circle/dev-auth run dev" "npm -w @care-circle/mcp-server run dev" "npm -w @care-circle/dashboard run dev" "npm -w @care-circle/simulator run dev:ui" "npm -w @care-circle/simulator run dev:agent"
